svg.title: C07-M03-F2: Signatures versus anomalies
svg.desc: A contrast of signature-based detection (precise, misses novel) and anomaly-based detection (catches novel, more false positives), recommending both.
svg.text: SIGNATURE: match KNOWN bad pattern -> precise, low FP, misses novel
ANOMALY : deviation from NORMAL -> catches novel, more FP, needs baseline
use BOTH: signatures for known threats, anomalies for the unknown
Figure C07-M03-F2. The two detection approaches are complementary [C07-M03-R1].
